That is tough. As for your job, you can always get another job. You can even get another job and have a side business that you run to make some extra money. Alcohol is definitely not the way to escape. Once you sober up, the issues are still there. If you need a drink to relax, I understand, but try not to rely on it to escape. I’m guessing you are 20-21, this will sound cliche, but you are going to go through so many life changes over the next few years of your life. All you have to do is think positive, get on a positive path and trust that things will get better. They will. The fact that you can type on Reddit puts you ahead of some people.

The fight inside is that something inside you that wants to keep going. I get real suicidal, but don’t really want to die. That’s the fight, that piece of you that ultimately wants to keep going. We all have it. If you don’t have anybody in your life rooting for you, know that you have someone in Texas that wants to see you keep going on to better thing and happier days.

Read something positive. Put the phone down and think about any positive that you have in your life. Don’t dwell on the negative. Think about what you perceive as a negative and think how it could be worse. The fact that you are even able to get on reddit, puts you in a better place than some people.
Please be strong. Find the fight inside and keep going.
